system.description:
• Effect: Trained in all aspects of mounted combat with no check required: saddle, mount, ride, dismount; control the mount in combat; guide with the knees; stay in the saddle when the mount rears or bolts; assess horse quality.
  • Your mount needs no check to charge, leap or fall softly: it does what you tell it
  • If your mount can attack (see Mounted Combat in The Arneyan Codex), it attacks as part of your action, with Advantage, and you have Advantage on your first melee attack each round from the saddle
  • Mounted manoeuvres: from the saddle you have three, always on:
    • Mounted Charge: a charge from the saddle uses your mount's movement (see Mounted Combat in The Arneyan Codex).
    • On a hit, a target no larger than your mount makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • A lance still doubles its damage dice.
    • Ride-By: after you attack from the saddle, your mount's remaining movement doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from the creature you attacked.
    • Overrun: once per round, in place of one of your attacks, your mount moves through a smaller creature's space; that creature makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
